payload.title: frick-protocol crate: MessagePack frame protocol + error envelope
payload.description: Rust implementation of the wire layer: compact MessagePack frame protocol (rmp-serde), schema identity struct (schemaId/schemaVersion/schemaRevision/schemaHash), and the structured error envelope. These are the stable surfaces clients rely on (per docs/versioning.md and docs/status.md) — byte-for-byte compatibility with packages/protocol is the bar. Extract golden wire fixtures from the TS implementation as the first conformance artifacts.
